card.name: Space before weight-based dose amounts
card.fires_on: The space right after 'is', 'of', 'than' or a bullet, just before a weight- or body-size-based dose such as 15 mg/kg or 600 mg/m2. It fires in dosing sections of drug labels.

modes.label: Before per-kg dose
modes.description: Space before a number that will be followed by mg/kg, often for patients under 50 kg or in pediatrics.
modes.example: For adult patients weighing less than 50 kg (actual body weight): The recommended dosage is<< >>15 mg/kg acetaminophen

modes.label: Before per-area or calorie rate
modes.description: Space before a number that will be followed by a per-body-size unit such as mg/m2 or kcal/kg/day.

card.writes: It promotes 'density' and related words, which looks like a loose link to per-size unit forms (amount per body measure) rather than a clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the spot just before a dose given per kilogram or per square meter of body size.
